title: Bench and senior record tokensCached; bench never counts skipped checks as passed

checks.name: wired
checks.cmd: grep -q 'tokensCached' src/nodes/bench.ts && grep -q 'tokensCached' src/nodes/senior.ts && grep -q 'checksSkipped' src/nodes/bench.ts

brief:
TypeScript run directly by Node 24. Attempt and Execution (src/types.ts, src/vault.ts) have an optional `tokensCached?: number`; src/nodes/agent.ts already records it as `tokensCached: res.tokensCached === undefined ? undefined : Math.round(res.tokensCached)`. Evidence has `checksSkipped?: string` (set when the checks were not run: no changes, or only out-of-scope changes; then evidence.checks is [] and checksOk is vacuously true).
1. src/nodes/bench.ts: in the recordExecution call add `tokensCached` the same way from the attempt `a` (a.tokensCached, rounded when defined); and make `checksPassed: !!ev && ev.scopeOk && ev.checksOk && !ev.checksSkipped`. If bench computes its own pass/fail `ok` from the evidence, apply the same `!ev.checksSkipped` condition there.
2. src/nodes/senior.ts: in the senior.decide node's recordExecution call add `tokensCached` from `a` the same way.
Change nothing else.

title: Parse mode for Command Code's NDJSON output
brief:
TypeScript run directly by Node 24 (imports end in .ts, no packages). Read CliAdapter.run in src/adapters/cli.ts (parse modes "claude-json", "out-file", text; then `classify(r.out, isError ? 1 : r.code, ...)`), `parse?:` in src/config.ts, and the disabled "commandcode" provider in config/orchestrator.json.
`commandcode -p --output-format json` prints NDJSON (one JSON object per line) and exits 0 even on errors. The last line is the result, e.g. success: {"type":"result","subtype":"success","finalText":"...","usage":{"inputTokens":10,"outputTokens":5,"cacheReadTokens":3,"cacheWriteTokens":0}}; real error: {"type":"result","subtype":"error","usage":{"inputTokens":0,"outputTokens":0,"cacheReadTokens":0,"cacheWriteTokens":0},"finalText":"","error":"Error: Insufficient credits for Command Code."}.
1. cli.ts: export `parseCommandCode(out: string): { text: string; isError: boolean; error: string; tokensIn: number; tokensCached: number; tokensOut: number } | null` that finds the LAST line parsing to an object with type "result" (skip lines that are not JSON); isError = subtype !== "success"; tokensIn = inputTokens + cacheWriteTokens; tokensCached = cacheReadTokens. Returns null when there is no result line.
2. Add parse mode "commandcode-json" (also to the union in src/config.ts) that uses it: text = finalText, isError, tokens; when isError, append the error text to what classify sees, e.g. classify(r.out + "\n" + error, 1, ...), so "Insufficient credits" becomes rate_limit.
3. config/orchestrator.json commandcode provider: "parse": "commandcode-json" and add ` --output-format json` to both run commands (keep "enabled": false; update its _note: the parse mode exists now, only credits are missing).
4. Create test/adapters.ts (node:assert/strict, prints `adapters PASS`): parseCommandCode on the success line gives the text and tokens 10/3/5; on the error line (with an event line before it) gives isError true and the error text; on "not json" gives null. package.json: append ` && node test/adapters.ts` to the test script.
Change nothing else.
